description: Draft, check and schedule X, LinkedIn, Bluesky, TikTok, YouTube and Pinterest posts, and by-hand Patreon handoffs, through Flaghand. Use when the user asks to write, schedule or publish social content. Ordinary future social posts need no per-post approval. TikTok uploads and YouTube videos need owner confirmation for each schedule or change. Each Pinterest Pin, email campaign, by-hand post, unpicked option and a new workspace's first plan also need owner confirmation. Only the owner posts immediately; agents never approve or post right now.
